title: Vowel-formant inspection tool example production data
manual_annotation_evidence: Public TextGrid has explicit word and vowel interval boundaries; README describes interactive human inspection of spectrogram/formants/pitch and manual mark/unmark workflow.
public_data_evidence: Repository contains sounds/, textgrids/, results/, stimuli.csv and source code; inspected TextGrid has 2 tiers and results file has 8 token rows with F0 F1 F2 F3 ratios duration position and voicing.
decision_notes: Materially ingested public example observations and interval annotations into source-faithful layer, but keep REVIEW rather than core ACCEPTED until primary-study/recording provenance and manual creation/correction provenance of boundaries are established.
